## Why This Is Asked

To assess practical mastery of per-tenant feature gating, canary deployments, and automated rollback in CNF gateways, including instrumentation and testability.

## Key Concepts

- Canary deployments, per-tenant isolation, ConfigMaps-based feature flags
- Argo Rollouts or Kubernetes Rollout, Prometheus alerts
- End-to-end validation, failure simulation

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-feature-flags
  namespace: tenant-A
data:
  enableNewGatewayPath: "true"
```

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-A-test
---
apiVersion: v1

  name: gateway-feature-flags
  namespace: tenant-A-test
data:
  enableNewGatewayPath: "true"
```

```yaml

      - pause: { duration: 5m }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test rollback under synthetic load? How to ensure isolation for other tenants during the rollback?

- Observability: circuit_open_rate, latency, eviction

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:

  windowSec: 30
  size: 50
```

```yaml
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: tenant-breaker-filter
  namespace: tenant-A
spec:
  workloadSelector:
    labels:
      app: cnf-gateway
  configPatches:
  - applyTo: HTTP_FILTER
    patch:
      operation: INSERT_BEFORE
      value:
        name: envoy.filters.http.circuit_breaker
        typed_config:
          type: type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.circuit_breaker.v3.CircuitBreaker
          maxConnections: 100
```

## Why This Is Asked
This probes practical design of per-tenant egress control, threat isolation, policy enforcement, and credential lifecycle in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant isolation via namespaces
- Egress policy enforcement (OPA, Envoy/iptables)
- Centralized per-tenant allowlists
- Certificate lifecycle (CSR/Vault)

## Code Example
```rego
package cnf.egress
default allow = false
allow {
  some t
  input.tenant == t
  dest := input.dest
  allowlist := data.allowlist[t]
  destInList(dest, allowlist)
}
destInList(dest, list) { dest == list[_] }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- What failure modes and observability would you add?

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates advanced telemetry architecture, per-tenant observability, dynamic sampling strategies, and operational safety practices for CNF gateways at scale.

## Key Concepts
- OpenTelemetry, OTLP, trace context propagation, and baggage
- Namespace-scoped configuration and feature flags
- Adaptive sampling policies with latency-aware thresholds
- Canary rollouts and rollback safety

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf.trace
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  cnf.trace.enabled: "true"
  cnf.trace.sample-rate: "0.25"
  cnf.trace.target: "otel-collector.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local:4317"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cnf-gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        env:
        - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.trace
              key: cnf.trace.target
      - name: otel-collector
        image: otel/collector:latest
        args: ["--config=/etc/otel/config.yaml"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: otel-config
          mountPath: /etc/otel
      volumes:
      - name: otel-config
        configMap:
          name: otel-collector-config
```

## Adaptive Sampling Implementation
```go
func AdaptiveSampler(sampleRate float64, errorRate float64) float64 {
    baseRate := sampleRate
    if errorRate > 0.05 {
        return min(1.0, baseRate*2)
    }
    return baseRate
}
```

## Rollout Strategy
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - pause: {duration: 5m}
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: error-rate-check
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        failedRunHistoryLimit: 3
```
